en_US.title: Pressure Crew Archetype Table
en_US.scanner: Crews are verbs: pump, seal, relay, map, forge, triage, cultivate, witness.
en_US.field_note: Eight crew families anchor the roster: Pump, Seal, Relay, Brine Map, Vent Forge, Triage, Pressure Botany, and Payload Witness.
en_US.terminal: CREW FAMILIES: Pump / Seal / Relay / Brine Map / Vent Forge / Triage / Pressure Botany / Payload Witness. Names attach to route function first.
en_US.audio: Job first. Memory second. That is how the colony survives.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Pressure crew archetypes keep worker evidence tied to systems the player can understand and repair.
en_US.external_site: Pressure crew archetypes tie colony names to work first: pump, seal, relay, brine map, vent forge, triage, pressure botany, and payload witness.

en_US.title: Seed Role Name Grammar
en_US.scanner: A seed can move a worker's evidence order, not turn them into disposable text.
en_US.field_note: Seed-role identities combine stable personal name, crew family, route permission, last task and object variant.
en_US.terminal: SEED GRAMMAR: personal_name + crew_family + route_permission + last_task + object_variant. Localization may annotate; it must not rewrite identity.
en_US.audio: Random is not authorship. Bind the name to a job.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Seed Role Name Grammar lets replay vary worker evidence while preserving authored human texture.
en_US.external_site: Seed Role Name Grammar keeps replay-safe colony names tied to personal name, crew family, route permission, last task, and object variant.
